text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ――YAAAAAAAAHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(—Everyone! Watch me!!
Witness the fireworks of my lifetime!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Oooooooooooh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Inari One comes charging in! Inari One! Inari One!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'M THE ONE...!!!
WHO'S AT THE VERY TOPPPP!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Across the finish line!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I did it—!!!!
Big sis did it!! Inari-nee won!!
She did it, she did it, yaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
Best in all of Japan!!
Congrats, Inari-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! You did it, Inari-chan!!
You're amazing, you were so magnificent!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Damn it all.
You've really gone and made me bawl my eyes out—

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text: —It was a historic race. This is the very race we dreamed of... the era we dreamed of...!!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
There is no definitive "strongest," only contenders clashing
relentlessly, shining brighter than ever!
A Golden Age without a single dull moment...!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Inari One. It's just been proven beyond doubt
that you are the greatest figure
shaping this entire era...!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text: "We cannot keep this era to ourselves! We must pass down the legacy of these dazzling stars who ignite our passion! Yes, they are—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I won—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I... won...!!
In this Arima Kinen!! I won!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Inari-cha~n!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations~!
It's very frustrating, but... it's my complete defeat.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Also—
I had so much fun running with you~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Creek—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Inari—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oguri...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race was like a festival,
and I had fun too."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I won't lose.
Congratulations on today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...I'm the one who ought to be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
To share a generation with you folks...
I truly am a blessed soul.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Because, y'know...
you can't hold a festival all by yourself!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: “—Let's do this again! A huge festival just like today! Definitely, someday again!”

text_block_list.name: Oguri & Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Right away~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Inari! Inari! Inari! Inari!
Inari! Inari! Inari! Inari!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe—
What an incredible view...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Boss!!
choice_data_list: You did it! You really... did it!!
We did it! We really... really did it!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Sis!!
choice_data_list: You did it! You really... did it!!
We did it! We really... really did it!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, what's with that!
You look like you're about to cry...!
Thanks to that, my own tears got sucked right back in!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—We finally managed to set off fireworks.
Great, massive ones, at that.
choice_data_list: We made it to the “top,” huh.
We made it to the “top,” didn't we.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
The two of us together!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well now--
How 'bout I set off
another firework right about now?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—To everyone gathered here!
Please lend me your ears!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume that I am wouldn't be here
without the downtown where I grew up and the races at Ohi!! And—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If not for every single Umamusume who ran with me today!
If not for the central Tracen Academy!
This race would never have been born!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This Arima Kinen
is the greatest fireworks display in history,
ignited by the massive passion of the NAR and JRA!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And right now!!
Shining at the center of those fireworks is—!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oi's very own stylish Umamusume!!
Yours truly, Inari One!!
Please, make sure you don't forget it!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I declare right here and now!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Regional or Central, it doesn't matter!!
Every single Umamusume! Every single race!!
They are all, equally, the absolute bestーーーー!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, at Nakayama Racecourse, the voices praising Inari One as she stood at the "very top" echoed long, loud, and strong—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A brief moment of time passed—

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text: Now then! In celebration of our boss, Inari One, winning Umamusume of the Year—

text_block_list.name: Downtown Folks
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Thanks, everyone!
For putting together a celebration like this for me!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! Don't be a stranger!
We threw a festival together for Inari-chan, didn't we?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, when you put it like that, I got nothing to say back!
Thanks a million for back then, really!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you were sooooo freakin' cool at the Arima Kinen!!
Seriously, you're who we all look up to!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Outta the way!
Get your butts over here and follow me!
That's what the Ohi spirit is all about, ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Inari One smile, surrounded by the people of
her beloved town, brought a tingling warmth
to the bridge of my nose—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: —As you get older, you just can't help turning into a crybaby.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Still, you're still young.
So for now, share a laugh and celebrate with your partner.
And then bring us old folks to tears.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
âCome on, Inari!
Don't just leave your partner hanging!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, the boss pushed me from behind,
shoving me right in front of Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, Boss!
Don't go wanderin' off on me out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, Sis!
Don't go wanderin' off on me out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Because you're my—
my one and only partner!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, beneath clear skies, a raucous festival
began to celebrate Inari One,
who had climbed all the way to the top—
